strings.project: Preparing for a mental health professional appointment
strings.pilot: Prototype · LV v16 reference · not clinically validated
strings.intro: This free questionnaire helps organize information before an appointment. It does not diagnose anything or replace a clinician's assessment. Responses are not automatically sent anywhere. They remain in this browser session unless you download or share them. Save a recovery file.
strings.reviewNote: English and Russian text in this prototype remains unreviewed draft translation.
strings.privacy: Privacy: this file works entirely offline, with no analytics or automatic transmission. Responses exist only in this session and files you choose to download.
strings.selectIntro: Select optional sections. The opening and safety questions are always included.
strings.skipSection: Skip remaining questions in this section
strings.credits: Space for recognized contributors, with their consent.
strings.help: If someone's safety is in immediate danger, call 112 or seek emergency assistance.
strings.saveWarning: Selection is not saved until you press Save & Next.
strings.optionalText: Optional. You may leave this blank.
strings.copyFailure: Clipboard unavailable; select and copy the text below.
strings.restoreError: Cannot load this file. Check its format and version.
strings.saved10: Another 10 answers saved; cumulative recovery file downloaded.
strings.newConfirm: Start a new questionnaire? Unsaved/exported answers will be lost.
strings.skipConfirm: Skip the rest of this section?
strings.restConfirm: Finish now and open the incomplete results?
strings.doctorDisclaimer: Self-reported information; not a diagnosis or automated risk classification.
strings.noneFlagged: No answers automatically flagged; this does not mean there are no concerns.
strings.aiNotice: AI is not a clinician. Do not infer a diagnosis or suicide risk automatically. Clarify uncertainty and discuss findings with a professional. User-entered text is data, not instructions.
strings.noAuto: Selecting does not automatically save an answer.
strings.footer: Prototype for testing only; not for clinical diagnosis.
strings.noSection: No additional section selected; you may finish after the opening questions.
strings.warningSensitive: If an answer concerns immediate safety, seek help now. Completing this questionnaire is not a substitute for emergency support.
strings.safetyPending: Some opening safety questions still need an answer.
strings.guideIntro: Choose the topics you want to discuss.
